turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You asked for this meeting, so start. I have until 4:40.
I'll stand. Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen asked anything before it went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you a question: who decided on the zero, and was Owen asked anything before it went in?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.

"Which battles are worth picking." This one is, Hale. The zero doesn't stand, and you still haven't told me who decided it or whether anyone spoke to Owen first, so I'll be in the principal's office when we're done.
